purpose: Teach: 亡くなら/戦わ/誤認/下回っ/採掘/投棄/抄/癒着

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦時、本気で、絶対、亡くなられた方々、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、立派、絶対、本当に、感心、本気で、絶対、本気。
lines.en: Ren, your paper on wartime casualties was genuinely impressive. The thoroughness of your research really struck me.
lines.style: Warm, measured appreciation. Slight pause before 'genuinely' to settle into sincerity. Even pacing, open expression. The tone of a teacher speaking to a student she respects.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。当時、本気で、絶対、戦われた人々の、生き様、論文で、扱いました、本気で、深い、研究、絶対、本気、本気で、感謝、本当に。
lines.en: Thank you. I wanted to treat the lives of those who lived through that era with real care in my research.
lines.style: Quiet gratitude with underlying conviction. Steady, thoughtful pace. Slight emphasis on 'care'—not defensive, but wanting to be understood. Meets her eye.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時、本気で、絶対、誤認による、逮捕、本気で、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、立派、絶対、感心、絶対。
lines.en: What impressed me most was how you handled the section on wrongful arrests during wartime. Your perspective was really broad.
lines.style: Measured, reflective. Slight lean forward—engaged. Warm but careful, as if choosing each word deliberately. Genuine curiosity underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。当時の経済、本気で、戦前を、絶対、下回った時代、論文で、扱いました、本気で、深い、研究、絶対、本気で、感謝、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: That was something I felt needed attention. The economic collapse of the era—how it fell below pre-war levels—seemed central to understanding what happened.
lines.style: Steady, slightly slower pace on the economic details. Voice carries weight here—he's thinking through the connection as he speaks. Genuine and unrushed.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時、本気で、絶対、鉱物採掘、本気で、軍事に、絶対、関わった歴史、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: And your discussion of mineral extraction and its military ties showed real depth. That's not always where students look.
lines.style: Appreciative, slightly surprised. Warm nod in the voice. Steady pace, clear articulation—marking each phrase as important. The genuine recognition of someone who notices careful work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。当時、本気で、絶対、不法投棄、絶対、深刻な、社会問題、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、感謝、絶対、本気で、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: I'm grateful you said that. Illegal dumping and environmental destruction were serious social problems then, and they tied into everything else I was examining.
lines.style: Humble but confident. Steady, thoughtful pace. Voice carries weight on 'tied into everything'—he's synthesizing, not just listing facts. Genuine and undefensive.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 当時の記録の抄録、本気で、絶対、貴重な、史料、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The archival excerpts you used were particularly valuable. Really excellent choices.
lines.style: Warm, final recognition. Slightly slower on 'particularly valuable.' Not effusive, but genuine—the kind of compliment a teacher gives when she means it fully.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。政治と財界の癒着、本気で、絶対、戦時、絶対、深刻、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本気、絶対、深い、研究、感謝、絶対、本気、絶対。
lines.en: Thank you. I spent a lot of time on the connections between political and corporate corruption during the war. It seemed like everything hinged on that.
lines.style: Sincere, measured, grounded. Steady pace with slight emphasis on 'everything hinged'—he's showing what he understood. Quiet conviction. Grateful but not deferential.
